question: How does the one Shiva become manifold principles?
premises: One Shiva shines as supreme form.
From his freedom, difference shines forth.
The manifold form becomes the lord's principle in teaching.
inference: The verse presents Shiva's free self-differentiation as the source of manifold principles.
uncertainties: The exact referent of former forms is compressed.
plain_english: The forms formerly spoken shine as the supreme light-dense god, one Shiva; again from the essence of his freedom, when difference shines forth from Shiva-status, that supreme manifold-following form becomes this principle of the lord in teaching.
